_comment: X12 publisher policy. A VALID signature caps MIE heuristics at LOW only if the leaf CN AND O both equal a 'publishers' entry AND the issuing CA is an 'issuing_intermediates' entry matched by CN AND SPKI sha256. An entry with spki_sha256 null is not usable (no cap) until SENTINEL pins it (python -m dexmond_mie.signature spki FILE.exe prints the values). Changes are reviewed commits.

legacy, root 2001, expired 2020; needs in-store countersignature
legacy second key, root 2001, expired 2017; needs in-store countersignature
root 2010, until 2035; signs Microsoft's own Windows binaries
